goal: Prevent dropped responses when an HTTP client pipelines requests ending with a connection close header
Ensures the server does not disconnect clients before queuing all pending responses
reviewability: Self-contained fix accompanied by a deterministic regression test
agreement: Support for updating keep-alive state alongside the send buffer to prevent inconsistent reads (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it resolves dropped responses during pipelined HTTP requests
Low severity bug because the race window is small and bitcoin-cli does not pipeline requests
